name: codex-run-budget
description: Shared token governance, native account quota sensing, and recent-task telemetry for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Quotas, Task reports and on-demand workflow observations.
interface.longDescription: Adds shared token governance and lifecycle diagnostics. Reads native quota, subscription and spend controls. Cross-task model/Fast/reasoning observations and dated token-credit scenarios stay separate from backend estimates and actual charges, without inventing per-model quota allocations or changing budgets.
defaultPrompt: Start a 100k shared run budget for this task.
Show the usage report scope menu without scanning history.
Report this Task's last 24 hours, with its Codex name and agent ownership.
Find the Tasks related to the work I describe, observe their workflow once, and suggest improvements without scheduling monitoring.
Show codex exec activity for this project, with launcher attribution and separate usage.
